_readme: Template for enhanced.json. Nothing here is live; the player only reads enhanced.json, which scripts/otr_enhanced_harvest.py regenerates.
The /otr setting 'enhanced audio when available' plays an entry's url instead of the catalog copy. Unmapped episodes play the regular copy.
Any better version is accepted: a cleaner or higher-generation transfer, a restoration, or an AI enhanced version. method is informational.
url must be a direct file that sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (archive.org download URLs do). No YouTube, Mixcloud, Spotify or web pages. Do not rehost on the droplet.
Keys: 'showId|YYYY-MM-DD|Title' (title is case and punctuation blind), 'showId||Title' when the title is unique in that show, or the archive filename stem.

duration is the enhanced file's runtime in seconds. Live channels play enhanced copies too, joining at the same fraction of the story; a different runtime shifts that listener off the shared clock by the difference.
An entry with url null is ignored, so placeholders are safe.
